text: Ɓeen goonɗinɓe e ngol leñol, e ɓeen goonɗin ɓe e leññi jawtuɗi ko adii nuleede Muhammadu (jkm) gila e yahuudu en e nasaara en e Saa'iba en - ɓeen ngoni rewɓe e yoga e annabaaɓe ɓe keɓi goonɗinde Alla e ñalaande watindiine- ɓeen na njogii mbarjaari to Jooma maɓɓe, ɓe kulanaaka ñande wattan, ɓe cunotaako e ko yawtiri ɓe to aduna.
